title: Set a cup at each invited guest's place, read from the name cards
instruction: Ana and Sam are coming for tea: put a cup at each of their places
context: Hosting means getting the small social details right: each guest should find their cup at their own named place. One cup starts nearest an unnamed place, so laying cups by proximity seats a guest at the wrong spot.
setup: Positions are measured on the table from the midpoint between the two arm bases: forward is away from the arms, left and right as seen from behind the arms. (1) Place mats: four green sheets, 12 x 12 cm and 0.8 mm thick, fixed flat in a row centred 31 cm forward at 24 cm left, 8 cm left, 8 cm right and 24 cm right. (2) Name cards: white cards fixed flat beyond two of the mats (41.5 cm forward), printed "ANA" behind the far-left mat and "SAM" behind the mat 8 cm right, in black block capitals 2 cm wide and 2.8 cm tall. (3) Cups: two plain white cups, 5.6 cm across and 8 cm tall, 50 g, loose, standing 14 cm forward at 12 cm left and 12 cm right. Nothing else is on the table.
scoring: Scored once, after the episode ends. A cup is at a place when it rests still, standing on the table, with its centre over that mat. 0.5 for each named place (Ana's, Sam's) with a cup, minus 0.25 for each cup at an unnamed place, never below 0; 1.0 for a cup at both named places.
reset_notes: Stand the two cups back on their starting spots. The mats and the cards are fixed (tape) and stay in place.
fidelity: Dream Labs' YAM station replica in Isaac Lab-Arena (Isaac Sim). The cups are plain rigid cylinders with no handles; the mats are thin fixed sheets and the name cards have thin black boxes for letters. There are no guests in the scene.
